DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) with possible concurrent Post-Nasal Drip Syndrome.

The clear temporal relationship between your meals/lying down and the cough, along with relief from antacids, strongly points to acid reflux irritating your airway. The sensation of a "drip" suggests allergies are also contributing to your chronic cough. I recommend a trial of a Proton Pump Inhibitor (PPI) taken before breakfast for 8 weeks, alongside an intranasal steroid spray and daily saline rinses to manage the post-nasal drip component.
